content:
STAGE: scope/eligibility screen of all six proposals against the five contract clauses.
READ: the six proposals plus every frozen evidence bundle (fab5ef5625b65791, 4bf56163b70e0975, a417488dd3f577d2, 40ac3b24c042bf37, b2e460e970104c8c, e06573d4519f3d92). Workspace file reads are permission-denied; the prompt bundle is the readable evidence.
OBSERVED: all six name a training-split behaviour signal (E1-E3 of each bundle), an explicit curved operation (E12/E11 of each), and place it in Stage-2 (E13). All six fail nothing outright on clauses 1,2,4,5. Differences are in clause 3 tightness: GDELTA-SUCC-PULL-RQ puts the behaviour term and the Poincare metric inside the same argmin that emits each SID digit; DELTA-TREE-STRESS-RQ puts a curved stress on the quantized code embedding at every residual depth; DELTA-PERI-CURV-RQ couples through a latent contrastive plus a curved commitment; LCB-RQ couples through the quantization target construction; SID-GW-DELTA couples through a batch pairwise distance stress; GROMOV-LCA-MOBIUS-RQ couples through a curved quantiser plus a Gromov-product rank match.
OPEN: need the observed-evidence anchors (E5/E6/E8/E9/E11) before any placement.

STAGE: extract the decisive observed anchors common to all six bundles.
READ: E4-E11 of the bundles.
OBSERVED, with locations: (a) E6 width-20 beam survival on 57,439 test rows: l1_br 0.04671, l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363, successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500; gold prefix alive at depths 1/2/3/4 for l1_br_euclid = 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085. So the target 0.065 sits just above the best observed 0.06363 and the bottleneck is depth-3/4 prefix survival, not depth-1. (b) E8 first-level capacity ceiling: share of canonical pairs sharing one of K clusters is K=16 0.3106, 32 0.2164, 64 0.1547, 256 0.0822, with the note that a small K is "what width-20 prefix survival depends on". (c) E11 baseline SIDs: same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067, i.e. the committed first prefix is only weakly behaviour-aligned. (d) E5: top-1 successor mass 0.4375 in the lowest entropy quintile vs 0.0543 in the highest, Spearman(entropy,top1) = -0.973, so the behaviour graph is strongly skewed and directional. (e) E9: positive shares successor cohort 0.9291 vs 0.8871 for negatives; overlap beats all ten negatives for only 0.5898 of pairs.
REASONING: any mechanism that only reorders continuous latents or global pairwise distances has to cross into committed prefix digits to move E6/E11; assignment-level and coarse-level mechanisms have the direct route, and a single global curvature is a poorer fit than a per-item one given E5's skew.
OPEN: comparative placement of the six.

STAGE: comparative placement, weighing scope tightness x evidence anchor x one-run probability x cost.
READ: proposals against E5/E6/E8/E9/E11 and each proposal's own risk list.
OBSERVED/DECIDED: (1) GDELTA-SUCC-PULL-RQ: only proposal whose behaviour term and per-item Gromov-delta Poincare metric live in the same per-level argmin, i.e. it changes which code wins at the digit that E8 says governs beam survival; s1/s2 are detached batch medians so the coupling weight is derived (=1, no sweep); 1-3% step cost. Risks are codebook concentration and a per-item metric family, both monitorable, not fatal. (2) DELTA-TREE-STRESS-RQ: acts on the quantized code embedding at every residual depth against an MST ultrametric, targeting exactly the depth-3/4 collapse in E6 and the coarse-level requirement in E8; tree metrics are the canonical low-distortion case for negative curvature so the geometry is necessary, but alpha (end of epoch 0) and lambda (first ten steps) are measured-once heuristics. (3) DELTA-PERI-CURV-RQ: measured per-item curvature reused four times is real coupling, but the primary lever is latent-side and its own risk 4 concedes the probe reads committed code vectors in Euclidean space, which E11 says is where the gap is; largest cost (+35-50 min) and the largest overpower-reconstruction risk. (4) LCB-RQ: target-side Lorentz barycentre is a genuine coupled pathway and E9 supports co-consumption cohorts, but the symmetric window +/-5 discards the directionality E5 measures, K init = 1 is not derived from measured hyperbolicity, and collapse/no-op are the biggest risks. (5) SID-GW-DELTA: global distance-matrix stress is clean and cheap, but E6's distance-geometry variants already lost to plain l1 variants (0.055 vs 0.062-0.064) and depth-3/4 survival is the bottleneck; uniform-item median normalisation and the underived 1.0 weight add risk. (6) GROMOV-LCA-MOBIUS-RQ: the most thoroughly curved quantiser, but the 64-leaf depth-6 binary-ish tree is far coarser than the 3x256 SID and E8 already caps level-1 K=64 at 0.1547; Gromov-product matching constrains only relative order and c=1 is the least data-derived curvature. Final order 1-6 as listed.
OPEN: emit the answer block as the last record.

STAGE: final answer (complete ranking, positions 1..6, no ties/gaps).
READ: nothing new; consolidates stages above.
ANSWER:
RANK: GDELTA-SUCC-PULL-RQ | position=1 | reason=Only proposal whose behaviour successor term and per-item Gromov-delta Poincare metric sit in the same per-level argmin that emits each SID digit, which is the lever E8 names (K=16 keeps behaviour neighbours together 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822 and small K is "what width-20 prefix survival depends on"), with detached-median unit scaling so the coupling weight is derived and 1-3% step cost.
RANK: DELTA-TREE-STRESS-RQ | position=2 | reason=Acts on the quantized code embedding at every residual depth against an MST ultrametric, matching E6's bottleneck (gold prefix alive 0.161/0.085 at depths 3/4 versus 1.000/0.829 at 1/2) and the coarse-level finding of E8, with a genuinely hyperbolic tree target, but alpha/lambda are measured-once heuristics and the one-near/one-far sampling weakens it versus position 1.
RANK: DELTA-PERI-CURV-RQ | position=3 | reason=Measured per-item Gromov-delta curvature is reused in distance, temperature, weight and commitment so the coupling is real, but the main lever is a latent-side contrastive and its own risk 4 concedes the probe reads committed code vectors in Euclidean space, while E11 (first-prefix 0.0907 vs null 0.067) locates the gap in the committed prefix; also the largest compute (+35-50 min Stage-2).
RANK: LCB-RQ | position=4 | reason=Moving the quantization target along a Lorentz geodesic to a co-consumption barycentre is a genuine coupled pathway and E9 supports the signal (positive cohort overlap 0.9291 vs negative 0.8871), but the undirected +/-5 window discards the directionality E5 measures (top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543 across entropy bins), K init = 1 is not derived from measured hyperbolicity, and collapse/no-op risks are the largest of the six.
RANK: SID-GW-DELTA | position=5 | reason=A global pairwise distance stress is clean and cheap, but E6 shows the distance/geometry variants already lost to plain l1 variants (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207 and l1_only 0.06233) and the failure is prefix survival at depths 3-4, not global distance order; uniform-item median normalisation and the underived 1.0 weight add risk.
RANK: GROMOV-LCA-MOBIUS-RQ | position=6 | reason=The Mobius/geodesic quantiser is the most thoroughly curved, but its 64-leaf depth-6 binary-ish behaviour tree is far coarser than the 3x256 SID it must organise, and E8 already caps level-1 K=64 at 0.1547; Gromov-product matching constrains only relative order and c=1 is the least data-derived curvature, so it is the least grounded in the observed prefix evidence.
OPEN: none; ranking handed in.
